L4.TCP.STATES.interpretation: All 11 RFC 9293 states with clean handshake, close, and RST/abort recovery.

L4.TCP.CC.interpretation: Bounded cwnd, ssthresh, rto_ms, unacked, dup_acks, retries, and snd_wnd.

L4.TCP.TIMER.interpretation: Retransmit, persist, and timewait timers remain strictly bound to valid active states.
